what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from India in Canada: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 48209 Indian asylum seekers in Canada, 26.6% of all asylum seekers from India.
Refugees from India, a separate group, live mostly in Canada and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Kashmir territory in India from 1995 to 2025, and over the government of India from 1996 to 2025 with groups including the PWG, MCC and CPI-Maoist.
The fact pack does not link these conflicts to the asylum figures.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 1315 asylum seekers.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2024 and 2025, and the figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Canada.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Canada only.
